message.reasoning:
We need to extract explicit facts.

Text: "Politics of Bosnia and Herzegovina

Politics of Bosnia and Herzegovina takes place in a framework of a parliamentary representative democracy, whereby executive power is exercised by the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Legislative power is vested in both the Council of Ministers and the Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Members of the Parliamentary Assembly are chosen according to a proportional representation system."

We need triplets.

Subject: "Politics of Bosnia and Herzegovina" (maybe entity type: political system or political entity). Relation: "type of government" maybe "form of government". The text says "takes place in a framework of a parliamentary representative democracy". So we can have relation "form of government" or "government type". Use "form of government". Object: "parliamentary representative democracy". Qualifiers none.

Triplet: subject "Politics of Bosnia and Herzegovina", relation "form of government", object "parliamentary representative democracy". subject_type maybe "political system". object_type "government type".

Next: "executive power is exercised by the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina." So subject "executive power" (maybe "executive branch") relation "exercised by" object "Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina". subject_type "branch of government". object_type "government body". Could also be "executive power" as concept. We'll create.

Triplet: subject "executive power", relation "exercised by", object "Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina". qualifiers none.

Next: "Legislative power is vested in both the Council of Ministers and the Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina." So two statements: legislative power vested in Council of Ministers; legislative power vested in Parliamentary Assembly. Relation "vested in". So two triplets.

Triplet1: subject "legislative power", relation "vested in", object "Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina". Triplet2: subject "legislative power", relation "vested in", object "Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina".

Next: "Members of the Parliamentary Assembly are chosen according to a proportional representation system." So subject "Members of the Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina" (or "Members of the Parliamentary Assembly") relation "chosen by" maybe "selection method". Could use relation "selection method" object "proportional representation system". Or "chosen according to" relation "electoral system". Use "electoral system". So triplet: subject "Members of the Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina", relation "electoral system", object "proportional representation system". Could also have subject_type "person" (members) but group. We'll set subject_type "group of people". object_type "electoral system".

Need to ensure pronoun resolution: "both the Council of Ministers and the Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina." Already explicit.

Now decide types.

- "Politics of Bosnia and Herzegovina": type "political system".
- "parliamentary representative democracy": type "government type".
- "executive power": type "branch of government".
- "Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina": type "government body".
- "legislative power": type "branch of government".
- "Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina": type "legislative body".
- "Members of the Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina": type "group of people".
- "proportional representation system": type "electoral system".

Now qualifiers none.
